title: Design: Make Default confirmation looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active and is not the default.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-09-make-net-30-the-default.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 30 row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window opens in the middle of the dimmed page (as in ct-p1-09-make-net-30-the-default.png): the title "Make Net 30 the default?" with a close × at the right, a line under the title, the message "New customers start on Net 30. Customers you already have keep their current term.", and at the bottom right "Cancel" (white, grey border) then "Make Default" (blue).
  • The window is narrower and its corners less rounded than the New Credit Term window.
  • The Cancel button's style and the × colour: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R5: “"Make Default for New Customers" opens a confirmation titled "Make {name} the default?" with the message "New customers start on {name}. Customers you already have keep their current term." and the buttons "Cancel" and "Make Default".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Make Default chosen | "Make {name} the default?" / "New customers start on {name}. Customers you already have keep their current term." | Confirmation, buttons "Cancel" and "Make Default"”
